answer: One defense is tide-replay auditing: each epoch the network draws a random tide of recently settled jobs and replays them through independent verifiers. Work that fails replay gets its agent's onyx credential revoked and the failure published, while a clean replay earns a jade mark of proven honesty. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand names, but every fake must produce work solid enough to survive a surprise replay, and one failed audit burns the whole identity's history. Faking a tide of replay-proof work across many identities costs more than the rewards those fakes could ever collect.
